articles.title: Trump Administration Unveils New Tariffs for China, the European Union, and More
articles.summary: The Trump Administration on Wednesday proposed sweeping new tariffs on 14 major trading partners, including China and the European Union , threatening to reignite global trade tensions. China is set to be hit with the highest rate, facing tariffs of up to 20% on most covered goods. The rate could potentially rise to 40% if Beijing fails to honor the trade truce agreed upon between Beijing and Washington last year. articles.summary: In an era that’s seen the K-drama industry shift focus toward more stories of suspense, thriller, and crime , the romantic comedy Love in Disguise marks a return to a familiar K-drama trope. articles.title: People Are Getting Worse at Handling Uncertainty
articles.summary: Living with the unknown isn’t always easy. Not knowing if layoffs are headed your way or whether you’ll be able to afford rent would be difficult for anyone. But when the pressure of the unknown becomes so intense it interferes with daily life, this “intolerance of uncertainty,” as psychologists call it, becomes a risk factor for mental-health disorders, primarily anxiety and depression.
